creator: Infinite Arena Studio
inputDescription: A jagged spike of anti-power mineral that silences solar and arcane gifts around it
environmentalInteractions: Placement is everything: planted on a choke point it denies solar and arcane fighters the ground they most want.
Pairs brutally with fighters whose kits carry neither tag — they fight at full strength inside the dead zone.
sideEffects: Suppresses BOTH teams' solar and magic expression inside its 6 m radius — drafting your own solar carry alongside it is on you.
High-tactical-intelligence enemy AI will actively move to destroy the shard.
counterplay: Destroy it — 60 integrity falls fast to focused or area fire.
Fight outside its 6 m radius and cede that patch of ground instead of your powers.
Draft fighters who rely on neither solar nor magic tags; the shard is a paperweight against them.
visualManifestation: A jagged obsidian-grey mineral spike shot through with dull violet veins; light and color visibly desaturate inside its radius.
audioManifestation: A flat, pressure-drop hum — abilities entering the zone cut out with a sound like a snuffed candle.
provenance: Curated Season 0 template: anti-power suppression object archetype.
